rationale.overall: B matches the REFERENCE’s glossy tubular object-on-plate read far more closely, so it wins overall despite A’s sharper mark at tiny sizes.
rationale.material: B reproduces the REF’s rounded pipe volume, hard specular ridge, soft contact shadow, and luminous orange translucency; A stays a flatter satin fill with only a thin bevel.
rationale.silhouette: A’s C-terminals and orange wedge stay crisper and more evenly gapped like a clean cut mark, while B’s highlights and softer edges slightly blur those cuts.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px A keeps a higher-contrast dark ring and a distinct orange chip, whereas B’s softer navy gradients and speculars smear the wedge and thin the edge.
